chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman who slandered a man, he said: 'She is whipped eighty lashes.'

key_terms.قَذَفَتْ: Slandered (specifically in the context of hadd al-qadhf)

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for a woman who slanders a man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi confirms that the hadd penalty for qadhf (slander) is uniform for both men and women, prescribing eighty lashes regardless of gender. It highlights the consistency of the Prophet’s tradition (Sunnah) in applying the Quranic verse 24:4, demonstrating that the female gender does not exempt one from this specific corporal punishment in Shia jurisprudence. The narration underscores the legal principle that the evidentiary requirements for qadhf apply equally to all adult Muslims.
